findings.passage: Opponents of existing gun safety laws blame such causes as social media, video games, mental health conditions, or the all-encompassing specter of ‘kids today’ to explain away the gun violence in the United States. None of these phenomena are unique to this country, yet only here are children subject to the omnipresent risk of mass shootings in schools. As a dad, first and foremost, I am pleased that the House has passed this legislation that will move our Commonwealth closer to freeing our kids of the unique trauma of our nation’s gun violence epidemic.
findings.note: Statement issued in his name after the House passed the firearm laws overhaul (H.4139); he thanks the Speaker and the bill's chair and welcomes the bill. Patch contributed release.
subjects: general gun safety laws
school shootings
